newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Martfu, Soproni'96 sales seen at HUF 12bln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Martfu, Soproni'96 sales seen at HUF 12bln.

text.p: Hungarian breweries Elso Magyar Szovetkezeti Sorgyar Rt and Soproni Sorgyar Rt are expected to generate combined sales revenues of over 12 billion forints in 1996, Brau Union Hungaria Kft said in a statement on Monday.
Brau Union, the exclusive distributor for the two breweries since the beginning of 1996, is 60-40 percent owned by Soproni and Martfu breweries.
Sopron and Martfu are both majority-owned by Austria's Brau Union AG.
Brau Union Hungaria holds a 22 percent state in the shrinking Hungarian beer market, annual consumption of which currently stands at around 7.5 million hectolitres, the statement said.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Sopron shares finished at 2,150 forints, up 25, while Martfu ended at 1,950 forints, up 150.
